speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: Oh, I can't say no to my little tushy face.

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: I'll be back soon. Do you want the regular peas or the Le Seur?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Thanks, Ma. Always Le Seur peas with lamb stew!

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: You're right! When you're right, you're right! What if they're out of the Le Seur?

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: All right! You don't have to yell!

speaker: bernadette_rostenkowski
text: Let me just put that on vibrate.

speaker: bernadette_rostenkowski
text: You know, that one I got. Howard, did you say something to Leonard about me?

speaker: bernadette_rostenkowski
text: He says if I go see his experiment tomorrow it might weird you out.

speaker: bernadette_rostenkowski
text: You're not jealous of Leonard, are you?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Me? No. I may have mentioned that it's a little inappropriate to be asking another man's girlfriend to his experiment without first discussing it with said man.

speaker: bernadette_rostenkowski
text: Are you saying I need to ask your permission to hang out with Leonard?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I didn't say anything like that. I said Leonard has to ask my permission. Come on, I don't want to eat lamb stew with my mother. Damn, I was this close on the bra.
